title: Lebanese banking sector: totals over time, and per-bank figures from the banks' own statements
metric_note: Sector series are ABL monthly totals (December 2023 and July 2024 to June 2026) plus IMF annual figures for 2011 to 2019. No single series spans 2020 to 2023. Per-bank rows come only from each bank's published consolidated statements on the Beirut Stock Exchange site; no ranking by ABL or any other body is used.

sector_series.label: Commercial banks: total assets
sector_series.unit: USD million at the legal rate
sector_series.basis: ABL 'Key Indicators' executive summaries (monthly bulletins built from Banque du Liban data). Consolidated balance sheet of commercial banks at month end, foreign-currency items at the legal rate in force (LBP 15,000 per USD for December 2023, LBP 89,500 from 31 January 2024), so USD figures are accounting values, not market values. Bulletins found cover December 2023 and July 2024 to June 2026; January to June 2024 and 2019 to 2022 are missing (the central bank site returns 403 to scripts).
